def solve(prices, split_factors):

    adjusted_prices = fin_skills.algorithms.adjust_prices(prices, split_factors)

    # Calculate the returns from the adjusted closes
    returns = adjusted_prices.pct_change()

    returns = returns.iloc[1:]

    # Initialize an empty DataFrame to store the weights
    weights = pd.DataFrame(index=prices.index, columns=prices.columns, dtype=float)

    # Define the lookback period
    lookback_period = 21

    # Iterate over each row starting from the lookback period
    for i in range(lookback_period, len(adjusted_prices)):
        # Get the closing prices for the current and previous periods
        current_close = adjusted_prices.iloc[i]
        previous_close = adjusted_prices.iloc[i - lookback_period]

        # Compute the momentum signal
        momentum_signal = np.sign((current_close / previous_close) - 1)

        # Compute the sample standard deviation of the last 20 returns
        std_dev = returns.iloc[i - lookback_period:i].std(ddof=1)

        # Compute the scaling factor
        scaling_factor = min(1, 0.10 / (std_dev * np.sqrt(252)))

        # Assign the weight based on the momentum signal and scaling factor
        weights.iloc[i] = momentum_signal * scaling_factor / 4

    return weights
